pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; head held high and level.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct head-on, front-facing view. The snout is pointed directly at the camera lens.
pose_constraints.grounding: All four feet visible but clustered closely together on flat, grey-green siltstone.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The entire length of the back, body, and tail is hidden directly behind the chest and head, ensuring the silhouette does not exceed a 280px horizontal width.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The shoulder spikes should extend symmetrically to the left and right, like 'ears', staying within the horizontal safe zone.

character_details.expression: Friendly, symmetrical smirk; large, soulful eyes looking straight forward.
character_details.texture: Pebbly skin with vibrant, heart-shaped plates visible 'stacking' upwards behind the head.

environmental_details.ground: Flat grey-green siltstone with light-colored mudcracks; no foliage near the feet.
flora: Jurassic conifers (Araucaria) framing the character on the far left and right edges only
environmental_details.sky: Bright, high-key Jurassic sky to create a crisp vertical silhouette edge.
